keywords.title: Text per outlet
keywords.description: Events in {calendar} become departures for an outlet only if the description contains that outlet's text as a separate word (e.g. MV1). Case does not matter. Leave empty for outlets this calendar should not control.

add_departure.name: Add departure
add_departure.description: Registers a manual departure for an outlet.

heater_id.name: Outlet (id)
heater_id.description: Outlet id, available as attribute heater_id on the Departures sensor.

departure_at.name: Departure time
departure_at.description: A time without time zone is read as local time.

edit_departure.name: Edit departure
edit_departure.description: Changes the time or label of a departure.

departure_at.name: New departure time
departure_at.description: A time without time zone is read as local time.

force_start.name: Forced start
force_start.description: Heats for the given number of minutes (max 240).

acknowledge_fault.name: Acknowledge safety lock
acknowledge_fault.description: Acknowledges the lock. Does not start the relay; that happens at the next heating period or a forced start.

skip_departure.name: Skip departure
skip_departure.description: Skips a departure (e.g. from the calendar) without removing it.

unskip_departure.name: Restore departure
unskip_departure.description: Makes a skipped departure active again.

stop_heating.name: Stop heating
stop_heating.description: Ends the current heating now: ongoing calendar departures are skipped, ongoing manual departures are removed and a forced start is cancelled. Upcoming departures are not affected.

options.keyword: Only events with text in the description
